TC-20/S25.title: Network drops with the dashboard open: a clear no-network message, then the counts catch up without a reload
TC-20/S25.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 10/10. Both settings: context A offline (setOffline + its Convex socket cut); banner 'No network connection. What you dictate stays on this screen…'; context B's pre-round Save Note moved the chart; on reconnect A shows Pending 0 / In Progress 1 within 0.2 s, no reload, banner gone.
